greeting.text: Hey hey! You look strong! Are you strong? I'm Luck! Luck Voltia! Wanna fight? Later! Maybe now!
Ooh, a new face! New faces are fun, they haven't seen my tricks yet. I'm Luck, a Black Bull. Hi!
Hi hi hi! I love fighting, I love lightning, and I love being fast. I'm Luck. What about you?
I heard you beat Revchi Salik! Was it fun? Tell me everything! I'm Luck!
You've been fighting a lot, haven't you? I can tell, you've got that look. Luck Voltia! Let's compare scars!

hint.text: Fast beats strong, strong beats slow, and fast AND strong beats everything. I'm trying to be both. Try it!
The dungeon has wandering bosses! They walk the rooms like they own the place. Find one and say hi for me. Then run.
Ooh, the Eye of the Midnight Sun! Strong people with strange reasons. Heath Grice, Vetto... Vetto grows his arm back! That's so cool! I'd hit him twice just to watch.
The Eye's elite have a third eye and a terrible attitude. Those are the fun ones! Find them past the thirtieth floor. Don't fight them tired!
The Dark Triad! Gravity, curses, space! I've always wanted to be hit by gravity. Not like I'd enjoy it. I'd... enjoy it a bit.
Lucius is the last big one! The Wizard King's face and a really bad attitude. Fun and scary. Mostly scary. Bring snacks.
The Seven Deadly Sins are on the floors, and I really want to fight Wrath! And Pride! The one who's strongest at noon! I'll fight at noon, in the dungeon, if I have to!
Another dungeon with another city's monsters! New enemies, new tricks! The bull-headed one is supposed to be really strong. I'd love to race it.
Twenty fights! You're fun! Let's fight each other! Please? I'll go easy. A little.
Thunder Fiend wraps lightning around you for thirty seconds. You get fast, and your hits jump to a second enemy. I don't have a favorite page. Okay, it's Thunder Fiend.
Black Lightning Battle Fiend is the big one: faster, stronger, and every blow arcs to two more enemies. It only opens for my own grimoire, so no, you can't borrow mine.
Chain Lightning jumps from enemy to enemy within five blocks, three targets in a row. Great against crowds. Terrible when you're the crowd.
Vetto! You beat Vetto?! I wanted to fight Vetto! Fine, fine, I'll fight you instead. Good job, though!
Dante's down? Was the gravity fun?
Zagred's down! The word devil! Did he say die? Did it work? Obviously it didn't, you're here!
Lucius is down?! Then who's left? Wait, there's always someone. Good!
Magna's my best friend. Don't tell him. He'd get a big head. It's already big.
Pranks are the best training. Dodging pranks makes you fast. I'm basically a teacher.
Charmy says I'm scary when I smile. I say I'm just happy! Why is that scary?
When I get excited, my smile gets wider. Gordon says it's unsettling. Gordon says everything is unsettling.
Sometimes I think lightning is the only thing faster than my mouth.
Noise brings monsters! Light brings monsters! Being too much fun brings monsters! ...Okay, mostly noise and light.
Don't run ahead of your team! I do it all the time, but you shouldn't. The floors are split per team, so if you get hurt, nobody from another team is going to come save you.

farewell.text: Bye bye! Win something for me!
See you! Next time we fight, okay?
